scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/core && npm run build:adapters && npm run build -w packages/vanilla
scripts.build:adapters: npm run build -w packages/react & r=$!; npm run build -w packages/vue & v=$!; npm run build -w packages/solid & s=$!; wait $r; a=$?; wait $v; b=$?; wait $s; exit $((a | b | $?))
scripts.type-check: npm run type-check -w packages/core && npm run type-check -w packages/react && npm run type-check -w packages/vue && npm run type-check -w packages/solid && npm run type-check -w packages/vanilla && npm run type-check -w demo/react -w demo/vue -w demo/solid -w demo/vanilla -w demo/showcase && tsc -p e2e
scripts.test: npm run test -w packages/core && npm run test -w packages/react && npm run test -w packages/vue && npm run test -w packages/solid && npm run test -w packages/vanilla
scripts.size: npm run size -w packages/core && npm run size -w packages/react && npm run size -w packages/vue && npm run size -w packages/solid && npm run size -w packages/vanilla
